model_annotation: The plot illustrates the inference time in seconds for various language models, comparing the performance of the base Llama model, Llama-1B, Llama-1B distillation models, and Llama-4B distillation models. The x-axis represents the batch size, measured in number of tokens, ranging from 0 to 512, with tick intervals of 32, 64, 128, 256, and 512. The y-axis represents the inference time in seconds, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6.5, with tick intervals of 0.5. The line labeled “Llama-1B” is a solid red line that begins at 0 seconds at a batch size of 0 and increases steadily to approximately 4.7 seconds at a batch size of 512. The line labeled “Llama-1B distillation” is a dashed blue line that starts at 0 seconds at a batch size of 0 and initially decreases to approximately 2.6 seconds at a batch size of 64, then gradually increases to approximately 4.3 seconds at a batch size of 512. The line labeled “Mamba-1B” is a solid green line that begins at 0 seconds at a batch size of 0 and increases steadily to approximately 3.7 seconds at a batch size of 512. Lastly, the line labeled “Mamba-4B” is a solid orange line that starts at 0 seconds at a batch size of 0 and increases steadily to approximately 4.7 seconds at a batch size of 512.
